d: Erica walks out of Betty Ford. Trevor visits Janet in jail and vows to kill her. Internal affairs is questioning Taylor about the bus crash. Then Janet hears her dark inner voice in her cell.
Tad's renewed commitment collapses when the shooting replay airs and Dixie walks out. Erica bolts from Betty Ford. Laura lands in Janet's jail cell as Janet's dark inner voice pushes for revenge.
Jason is recognized at an AA meeting for his role in the shooting. Kelsey agrees to breastfeed Edmund and Maria's baby. Brooke takes in Laura, and Janet's inner voice turns on Brooke for it.
Liza celebrates big ratings while Tad watches his marriage pay the price. Noah and Julia find a dead body on the cargo ship. Jason flashes back to the shooting and sees who had the gun.
At Laurel's funeral, Jason's memory breaks through, and he sees himself firing the gun that killed her. Trevor throws Tad and Liza out. The body Noah and Julia found has mysteriously vanished.
Jason confesses to Hayley at an AA meeting that he shot Laurel. Erica returns to Betty Ford with Dr. Kinder's help. Trevor doubts Janet was the killer. Noah and Julia swim for it as guards open fire.
News of a friend's death at Betty Ford reaffirms Erica's commitment. Noah and Julia reach Jamaica. Jason forces a kiss on Dixie, then Hayley gives him 24 hours to go to the police before she does.
Kelsey refuses to sign the adoption papers and is falling for Edmund. Liza fires Jason. Then Jason walks in on Michael and Kevin and tells Michael it should have been him who died, not his sister.
Janet acts as her own attorney and chips away at the state's case. Hayley struggles to stay quiet about Jason while he hides behind AA rules. Then the state calls Jason Sheffield to the stand.
